basic_details.job_title: DCPU Tiruppur Support Persons Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 20 Posts
basic_details.short_information: District Child Protection Unit Tiruppur (DCPU Tiruppur) Support Persons Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 12 August 2026. A total of 20 vacancies have been announced through the DCPU Tiruppur Support Persons Recruitment 2026.

qualification.details: Postgraduate degree in Child Welfare, Healthcare, or education-related fields, specifically social work, sociology, law, psychology, or child development from any recognized university. (Or) Bachelor's degree with at least 3 years of experience in child education, development, healthcare, or protection-related fields. | Minimum age 25 years and above.

content_sections.heading: DCPU Tiruppur Support Persons at a Glance

rows.details: District Child Protection Unit Tiruppur (DCPU Tiruppur)
Tamil Nadu Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government Order (St) No. 23
Up to Rs. 10,000/- per case in four instalments of Rs. 2,500/- each (inclusive of travel expenses)
Postgraduate or Bachelor's degree in relevant fields

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Completed application forms along with necessary documents should be submitted either in person or by post to the following address: District Child Protection Unit (DCPU), Room No. 705, 7th Floor, District Collectorate, Tiruppur – 641604

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Postgraduate degree in Child Welfare, Healthcare, or education-related fields, specifically social work, sociology, law, psychology, or child development from any recognized university. (Or) Bachelor's degree with at least 3 years of experience in child education, development, healthcare, or protection-related fields. Minimum age 25 years and above.

rows.pay: Rs. 10,000/- per case maximum (disbursed in 4 instalments of Rs. 2,500/- each, including travel cost)

content_sections.heading: DCPU Tiruppur Support Persons Job Description
content_sections.text: Support Persons must work in coordination with the police, CWC, DCPU, hospitals, and courts, keeping the child's best interests, protection, and rights in mind. Provide necessary medical, psychological, educational, and rehabilitation support to the child. Assist in tracking case progress and providing necessary information to the child and family to ensure the child's protection.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Filled application form downloaded from the official website Supporting educational and experience documents

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 20 vacancies are available for Support Persons.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit applications?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Support Persons?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a postgraduate degree in child welfare, healthcare, social work, sociology, law, psychology, or child development, OR a Bachelor's degree with at least 3 years of experience in child education, development, healthcare, or protection.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be a minimum of 25 years of age and above.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and submit it either in person or by post to the DCPU office at the District Collectorate, Tiruppur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the tenure and remuneration for Support Persons?
faq.answer: The tenure is 3 years, and remuneration is provided up to Rs. 10,000/- per case allocated, paid in four instalments of Rs. 2,500/- each including travel expenses.
